title: Install and validate official Qwen3 14B native tool calling
description: Pull the official Ollama qwen3:14b model, validate that its current Ollama template/API returns a real structured message.tool_calls entry for the standard write_probe schema, persist evidence, and do not change OpenClaw configuration yet.
script:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge';$ep=Join-Path $root 'ollama-endpoint-v414.json';$base=(Get-Content $ep -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json).baseUrl;$model='qwen3:14b';Write-Output ('V444_057M_PULL_START='+$model);$pullBody=@{model=$model;stream=$false}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5;$pull=Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri ($base+'/api/pull') -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $pullBody -TimeoutSec 1800;Write-Output ('V444_057M_PULL_STATUS='+[string]$pull.status);$show=Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri ($base+'/api/show') -ContentType 'application/json' -Body (@{model=$model}|ConvertTo-Json) -TimeoutSec 60;$caps=@($show.capabilities);$supportsTools=($caps -contains 'tools');$tool=@{type='function';function=@{name='write_probe';description='Create a probe file';parameters=@{type='object';properties=@{path=@{type='string'};content=@{type='string'}};required=@('path','content')}}};$body=@{model=$model;stream=$false;messages=@(@{role='system';content='You are a tool-using agent. When a matching tool is available, call it. Do not answer with JSON, XML, markdown, or prose instead of a tool call.'},@{role='user';content='Call write_probe exactly once with path C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/qwen3-native-tool-probe.txt and content QWEN3_NATIVE_TOOL_OK.'});tools=@($tool);options=@{temperature=0}}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 30;$resp=Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri ($base+'/api/chat') -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body -TimeoutSec 600;$msg=$resp.message;$props=if($null -ne $msg){@($msg.PSObject.Properties.Name)}else{@()};$tc=@();if($null -ne $msg -and ($props -contains 'tool_calls') -and $null -ne $msg.tool_calls){$tc=@($msg.tool_calls)};$toolCount=$tc.Count;$structured=($toolCount -gt 0);$content=if($null -ne $msg -and ($props -contains 'content')){[string]$msg.content}else{''};$preview=($content -replace '[
]+',' ');if($preview.Length -gt 500){$preview=$preview.Substring(0,500)};$calls=@($tc|ForEach-Object{[pscustomobject]@{name=[string]$_.function.name;arguments=$_.function.arguments}});$artifact=Join-Path $root 'qwen3-14b-native-tool-validation.json';[pscustomobject]@{testedAt=(Get-Date).ToString('o');endpoint=$base;model=$model;pullStatus=[string]$pull.status;capabilities=$caps;supportsTools=$supportsTools;messageProperties=$props;toolCallCount=$toolCount;structured=$structured;toolCalls=$calls;contentPreview=$preview}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20|Set-Content $artifact -Encoding UTF8;Write-Output ('V444_057M_CAPS='+($caps -join ','));Write-Output ('V444_057M_MESSAGE_PROPS='+($props -join ','));Write-Output ('V444_057M_TOOL_CALL_COUNT='+$toolCount);foreach($c in $calls){Write-Output ('V444_057M_TOOL_CALL='+$c.name+' args='+($c.arguments|ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 10))};Write-Output ('V444_057M_STRUCTURED='+$structured);Write-Output ('V444_057M_ARTIFACT='+$artifact)
